behavior.global: Existing normal grid interleaves the global all-wallet active pack page with OG tokens; no connected wallet required.
behavior.profile: Existing normal holdings grid interleaves exact resolved Base-owner pack pages with OG holdings. Hidden-only view excludes pack cards.
behavior.identity: chain:contract:tokenId for EVM, chain:mintAddress for Solana; pack and OG token1 remain separate.
behavior.ranking: OG scores/market/visibility/leaderboards are preserved unchanged; pack cards have no rarity, market or Arena controls.
behavior.filters: Chain plus four pack traits and profile name/token search apply to loaded pack cards. Other traits/ranking/sale filters apply to originals as explained beside grid.
behavior.pagination: Independent bounded24-item source cursor with Load more pack cards; retains existing OG forward/back or infinite cursor, no whole-collection fetch. Filtered pages with a continuation retain the load action.
behavior.artwork: Existing shared-variant query cache and BoosterCardViewer, detail links use collection+token identity.

apiRequirement.response: Existing ready-prefix BoosterPage<BoosterMonster> with numeric ASC tokenId cursor, active minted NFTs only.

checks: disconnected global collection combines all-owner pack cards and OG token1 in the same normal grid without identity collision, rank or trade controls
independent bounded pack continuation adds cards once and preserves OG results
shared color and chain filters apply while unrelated OG special/ranking filters do not silently hide pack cards
collector uses only the resolved profile owner endpoint and follows that owner's cursor without exposing another owner's cards
hidden-only profile view excludes public pack cards and restoring visible view returns them without a separate gallery
wrong-owner API response is refused while the owner's OG grid remains usable

remaining: Parent independent review, global route API publication and canonical frontend build/deploy.
